pruning: Nothing of zlib is vendored: the library is compat.zlib 1.3.2's, from the same tarball, and the macros of include/mwrap/zlib/macros.hpp are upstream's definitions, written out by tools/generate.py. Its README and license are retained here. The conformance run builds the release's test/example.c and test/infcover.c against compat.zlib, from the tarball downloaded at test time.
